children: WLD price is gaining momentum as the token pushes higher after months of consolidation. The latest move has brought WLD back toward a key resistance zone, while on-chain activity is showing stronger participation from the network. Active Addresses have picked up, MVRV has moved deeper into positive territory, and Social Dominance is rising alongside the recovery. With the broader crypto market beginning to turn positive, traders are now watching whether WLD price can break through the $0.65–$0.75 zone and extend the rally.
Active Addresses Surge as WLD Holders Move Into Profit

The strongest on-chain signal is the simultaneous rise in 24-hour Active Addresses and 30-day MVRV. Active Addresses have climbed to around 1,215, showing a sharp increase in network participation as WLD accelerates higher. Meanwhile, the 30-day MVRV Ratio has reached 15.6%, indicating that recent buyers are holding meaningful unrealized gains.

The combination gives the rally a stronger foundation than price momentum alone. More addresses are becoming active while existing participants are moving further into profit. The setup also creates a potential profit-taking zone as WLD approaches higher resistance. Sustained growth in Active Addresses would support the continuation of the rally, while a sharp MVRV reversal alongside falling activity would signal weakening participation.
Social Dominance Rises as WLD Re-Enters the Spotlight
WLD’s Social dominance has climbed to around 0.013%, reflecting a renewed increase in market attention as the token pushes higher.

The rise comes as World expands its Proof of Human infrastructure into the rapidly developing AI-agent economy. World recently highlighted World ID as a way for AI agents to prove that a real person initiated an action, while its peaqOS integration extends the identity layer toward physical AI and machine commerce.

World’s broader ecosystem now positions World ID around applications spanning AI agents, consumer platforms and machine-based transactions. The increase in social attention gives WLD another momentum driver as traders watch whether the current breakout can move into a larger trend.
WLD Price Analysis: Can Bulls Break $0.70?

WLD is trading around $0.56–$0.57, after a strong recovery from the September lows. Market data shows the token rising from roughly $0.37 at the start of September to the current region, with the latest move accompanied by rising trading activity. WLD price chart shows a broad rounded-bottom structure developing after the prolonged decline. WLD has reclaimed the $0.50 area and is now approaching the first major resistance around $0.65–$0.70.

A decisive move through $0.70–$0.75 would complete a larger bullish reversal and place higher resistance levels into focus. On the downside, $0.50–$0.52 is the first important support, followed by $0.40–$0.42. RSI is reaching overbought zone, but remains below extreme levels, leaving room for additional upside if volume and participation continue expanding.

The current setup leans bullish because price momentum, network activity and market attention are moving together. Active Addresses are rising, MVRV remains firmly positive and Social Dominance is recovering as World expands its AI and Proof of Human narrative.

The major test is now the $0.65–$0.75 resistance zone. A clean breakout would strengthen the broader rounded-bottom reversal and give the rally room to develop into a larger uptrend. A rejection would put the recent breakout under pressure and bring the $0.50 region back into focus.

title: WLD Price Nears $0.70 Resistance — 3 On-Chain Signals Reveal the Next Move
